messages.author: Maciej Spiegel
messages.body:
Hello,
I have *slightly* overcharged and my *.nc trajectory file weights 8.1GB. Is it possible, using cpptraj or other code, to extract every 10th frame starting from the first one, to the new file? There’s an option [onlyframes] but it doesn’t let specify stepsize.
Thanks.
–
Maciej Spiegel, MPharm PhD
assistant professor
Department of Organic Chemistry and Pharmaceutical Technology,
Faculty of Pharmacy, Wroclaw Medical University
Borowska 211A, 50-556 Wroclaw, Poland

messages.author: Timothy Giese
messages.body:
I'd probably use cpptraj to read every 10th frame and then write a new trajectory file. Something like this:
parm mysystem.parm7
trajin big.nc 1 last 10
trajout small.nc
run
quit

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
Yes this is done using "trajin first last stride".
Then you can do trajout for just the frames read.
